details:
- CVE-2026-60075: reject a date or time string longer than 256 characters
  before any parsing regex runs. The unanchored time substitution in
  _parse_time backtracks quadratically across an interior whitespace run,
  so a long string of spaces caused CPU exhaustion without containing any
  time at all.
- Drop the test suite invocation and its perl(Test::Inter) and
  perl(Test::More) build requirements. perl-Test-Inter is not shipped in any AlmaLinux 9.2
  repository, so the dependency could not be resolved in the 9.2 buildroot
  and the binary build failed before the build stage. The test suite is not
  part of the shipped package.
